difficulty_why: Unlisted Marketplace OAuth apps can connect up to 25 accounts immediately without prior review, but connecting any customer beyond 25 installs requires passing HubSpot Marketplace review and publishing a public listing.

dev_time.label: 15-30 min
dev_time.text: Time to create a free developer project via CLI or UI, configure OAuth credentials, set redirect URIs and scopes, and test in a test account.

launch_time.label: 2-3 weeks
launch_time.text: Unlisted OAuth apps can connect up to 25 accounts immediately on day one, but opening access to unlimited customers requires Marketplace review, which takes up to 10 business days plus resolution time for any reviewer feedback.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom Branding on Consent Screen
own_app_reasons.text: Displays your own product name, company logo, and verified domain on the HubSpot OAuth permission screen instead of third-party branding.

own_app_reasons.label: Granular Scope Control
own_app_reasons.text: Allows requesting only the exact scopes your integration needs while excluding deprecated scopes (such as accounting or e-commerce) and handling tier-restricted scopes appropriately.

app_type.label: OAuth App (Developer Platform / Marketplace)
app_type.text: OAuth app with marketplace or public distribution. Any integration intended for installation across multiple HubSpot accounts must use OAuth authentication rather than single-account private app access tokens.

prerequisites.label: Standard HubSpot Account
prerequisites.text: A standard HubSpot account (free, no credit card required) provides the integrated Development section for creating and managing apps.

prerequisites.label: HubSpot CLI and Node.js
prerequisites.text: Node.js (v20+) and @hubspot/cli installed to initialize and deploy app projects using 'hs project' commands.

prerequisites.label: Verified Company Domain
prerequisites.text: Access to your domain's DNS management to configure a TXT record for domain verification and avoid the unverified app warning.

prerequisites.label: App Metadata and Support URLs
prerequisites.text: App logo, support contact email, public documentation URL, and terms of service URL.

prerequisites.label: Signed Acceptable Use Policy
prerequisites.text: HubSpot Acceptable Use Policy signed in the app Distribution settings prior to installing in non-test accounts.

steps.label: Navigate to Development in HubSpot
steps.text: Sign in to your standard HubSpot account and navigate to the Development section in the main navigation.

steps.label: Initialize App Project
steps.text: Create an app project using the HubSpot CLI (`hs project create`) or under Development > Projects. Set auth type to 'oauth' and distribution to 'marketplace' in app-hsmeta.json.

steps.label: Configure Redirect URI
steps.text: Add 'https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add' to the redirectUrls field in app-hsmeta.json or in the Auth tab under Redirect URLs.

steps.label: Configure Required and Optional Scopes
steps.text: Add the required scopes to your project configuration. For tier-dependent scopes like 'crm.objects.custom.read', mark them as optional to avoid blocking non-Enterprise customers.

steps.label: Deploy App Project to HubSpot
steps.text: Deploy your project configuration to your HubSpot account by running `hs project upload` in your local terminal.

steps.label: Accept Acceptable Use Policy
steps.text: In the HubSpot web UI, go to Development > Projects > [Your Project] > [Your App] > Distribution tab, click 'Begin publishing', and sign the Acceptable Use Policy.

steps.label: Copy Client ID and Client Secret
steps.text: Under Project Components, select your app name and open the Auth tab. Copy the Client ID and Client secret from the Client credentials section.

scopes.label: crm.objects.contacts.read
scopes.text: crm.objects.contacts.read: Read contacts and contact properties. Standard scope; must be reflected in the Marketplace listing Shared Data table.

scopes.label: crm.objects.contacts.write
scopes.text: crm.objects.contacts.write: Create and edit contacts. When combined with read scopes, Marketplace review mandates explaining bidirectional sync in documentation.

scopes.label: crm.objects.custom.read
scopes.text: crm.objects.custom.read: Read custom CRM object schemas and records. Requires Enterprise tier on the installing account; must be marked optional to avoid failing standard installs.

scopes.label: crm.export
scopes.text: crm.export: Bulk export CRM records. Grants high-privilege data extraction; requires Super Admin permission on the installing account.

scopes.label: accounting
scopes.text: accounting: Legacy accounting extension scope. Deprecated by HubSpot; recommended to exclude from new app configurations.

scopes.label: e-commerce
scopes.text: e-commerce: Legacy e-commerce bridge scope. Deprecated by HubSpot; recommended to exclude from new app configurations.

approval.label: When required
approval.text: Review and Marketplace listing approval are required once an unlisted Marketplace-distribution OAuth app reaches 25 customer account installs. Review is not triggered on a per-scope basis.

approval.label: What's checked
approval.text: HubSpot Ecosystem Quality team verifies OAuth implementation, at least 3 active unaffiliated installs, scope necessity, crawlable setup and support documentation URLs, pricing plan accuracy, and shared data tables.

approval.label: Wait
approval.text: Initial review is completed within 10 business days; feedback and revision cycles must be completed within 60 days of feedback delivery.

approval.label: Cost
approval.text: Free. HubSpot does not charge a fee to register an OAuth app or submit it for Marketplace listing review.

approval.label: Common rejections
approval.text: Support or documentation URLs blocking the HubSpot Crawler bot, requesting scopes not actively utilized by the app, missing bidirectional data explanations for write scopes, or having fewer than 3 active unaffiliated installs.

approval.label: Before approval
approval.text: Apps created with marketplace distribution can be installed in up to 25 accounts before approval; apps distributed privately via OAuth can be installed in up to 10 accounts (100 for Solutions Partners).

approval.label: Install cap before review
approval.text: 25 installs for Marketplace distribution apps before Marketplace approval; 10 customer accounts for private OAuth distribution apps (100 for Solutions Partners).

approval.label: Limits until reviewed
approval.text: Marketplace OAuth apps are limited to 110 requests per 10 seconds per installing account (excluding CRM Search). Private OAuth apps are limited to 100 req/10s (Free/Starter) or 190 req/10s (Pro/Enterprise) burst, and shared daily account caps (250,000 to 1,000,000 requests/day).

pitfalls.label: Unverified Domain Install Warning
pitfalls.text: If domain ownership is not verified with a DNS TXT record, HubSpot displays a warning banner during authorization prompting users to manually type 'I accept the risk' to proceed.

pitfalls.label: 25-Account Install Cap Before Review
pitfalls.text: Unlisted Marketplace OAuth apps are hard-capped at 25 installing accounts; exceeding this limit requires completing full Ecosystem Quality team review and publishing a Marketplace listing.

pitfalls.label: Tier-Restricted Scopes Cause Install Failure
pitfalls.text: Scopes like 'crm.objects.custom.read' require an Enterprise HubSpot tier on the installing account. If marked as required rather than optional, non-Enterprise customer installs will fail immediately.

pitfalls.label: Deprecated Scopes in Default List
pitfalls.text: Default scope lists frequently include 'accounting' and 'e-commerce', which are deprecated by HubSpot and should be omitted to avoid rejection during Marketplace review.

pitfalls.label: Minimum 3 Unaffiliated Active Installs Requirement
pitfalls.text: Marketplace review cannot be initiated until the app has at least 3 active, unique customer accounts unaffiliated with your company making API calls within the last 30 days.

pitfalls.label: HubSpot Crawler Bot Rejections
pitfalls.text: HubSpot Crawler scans your terms, privacy, and support URLs; if your web host or Cloudflare blocks the crawler bot, review submission is automatically rejected back to Draft mode.

support.label: HubSpot Developer Documentation
support.text: Official developer platform documentation covering OAuth implementation, scope references, and app configuration guides.

support.label: HubSpot Developer Community
support.text: Community forum for troubleshooting integration issues, OAuth flow edge cases, and platform setup questions.

email_subject: Inquiry regarding HubSpot OAuth app distribution limits and Marketplace review process
email_body:
Hi HubSpot Developer Support Team,

We are developing an AI agent integration that connects customer HubSpot accounts via OAuth 2.0 so our users can manage CRM objects, lists, and settings.

We have a few questions regarding our OAuth app configuration and distribution:
1. We plan to configure OAuth distribution for our multi-tenant application. Confirming our understanding: can we connect up to 25 customer accounts during our unlisted phase before submitting for full Marketplace review?
2. Our integration connects via standard OAuth 2.0 with redirect URI [https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add]. Are there any specific requirements or restrictions regarding third-party hosted redirect endpoints?
3. Several default scopes (such as accounting and e-commerce) are marked as deprecated in recent developer documentation. Should these be excluded from newly submitted apps?
4. What is the current turnaround time for the Ecosystem Quality team's Marketplace listing review once we reach the 25-account threshold?

App Details:
- App Name: [App Name]
- Developer Account ID: [HubSpot Portal ID]
- Contact Email: [Your Email]

Thank you for your guidance.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Company]
